title: Spicy delicious chicken wings
description: Crispy baked chicken wings tossed in a spicy, flavorful chili sauce with garlic and herbs. Perfect appetizer for gatherings or game night.

ingredientGroups.title: For main dish
items: 1 kg chicken wings, split at joints

instructions.title: Prepare wings
instructions.text: Pat chicken wings dry with paper towels. Toss with baking powder, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.

instructions.title: Bake or fry
instructions.text: Bake in a preheated oven at 200°C (400°F) for 25-30 minutes until crispy and golden brown.

instructions.title: Toss in sauce
instructions.text: Whisk hot sauce, melted butter, and honey together. Coat cooked wings in sauce and serve immediately.

title: Health Japanese Fried Rice
description: Authentic Japanese style fried rice packed with fresh vegetables, egg, and light soy sauce. A quick, delicious, and healthy weeknight meal.

ingredientGroups.title: For main dish
items: 1/2 cup mixed diced carrots and peas

instructions.title: Cook chicken & eggs
instructions.text: Heat sesame oil in a wok. Cook diced chicken until golden, then scramble eggs on one side of the pan.

instructions.title: Stir-fry vegetables & rice
instructions.text: Add carrots, peas, and chilled cooked rice. Stir-fry on high heat for 3-5 minutes.

instructions.title: Season and serve
instructions.text: Pour in soy sauce and garlic. Toss well until heated through and garnish with green onions.

title: Big and Juicy Wagyu Beef Cheeseburger
description: Delicious Wagyu beef cheeseburger served with melted cheddar, fresh lettuce, tomatoes, and custom burger sauce on a toasted brioche bun.

instructions.title: Sear the patty
instructions.text: Season Wagyu patty with salt and pepper. Cook in a skillet over high heat for 3-4 minutes per side.

instructions.title: Melt cheese & toast bun
instructions.text: Place cheddar cheese on the patty to melt. Lightly toast the brioche bun in the pan juices.

instructions.title: Assemble burger
instructions.text: Spread sauce on the bottom bun, add lettuce, tomato, Wagyu patty with cheese, and top bun.

title: Fresh Lime Roasted Salmon with Ginger Sauce
description: Fresh roasted salmon fillet topped with vibrant lime zest, garlic, and served with a zesty ginger dressing.

instructions.title: Marinate salmon
instructions.text: Rub salmon with olive oil, lime zest, salt, pepper, and fresh lime juice.

instructions.title: Roast in oven
instructions.text: Roast at 200°C (400°F) for 12-15 minutes until salmon flakes easily with a fork.

instructions.title: Drizzle ginger sauce
instructions.text: Mix ginger, soy sauce, and honey. Drizzle over warm salmon before serving.

title: Strawberry Oatmeal Pancake with Honey Syrup
description: Healthy oatmeal pancakes topped with organic sliced strawberries and sweet raw honey syrup.

ingredientGroups.title: For the sauce
items: 2 tbsp organic honey or maple syrup

instructions.title: Blend batter
instructions.text: Blend oat flour, almond milk, egg, and baking powder until smooth.

instructions.title: Cook pancakes
instructions.text: Pour batter onto a lightly greased non-stick skillet. Cook 2-3 minutes per side.

instructions.title: Top & serve
instructions.text: Stack pancakes, top with fresh strawberry slices, and pour honey syrup on top.

title: Fresh and Healthy Mixed Mayonnaise Salad
description: Crisp mixed greens with light mayonnaise dressing, chickpeas, cucumbers, and cherry tomatoes.

instructions.title: Prep vegetables
instructions.text: Wash salad greens, cut cucumbers and tomatoes, and drain chickpeas.

instructions.title: Mix dressing
instructions.text: Whisk light mayonnaise, lemon juice, salt, and oregano in a small bowl.

instructions.title: Toss and serve
instructions.text: Combine vegetables and chickpeas in a salad bowl, toss gently with dressing.

title: Chicken Meatballs with Cream Cheese
description: Tender baked chicken meatballs paired with creamy cheese dip, fresh herbs, and garlic seasoning.

ingredientGroups.title: For main dish
items: Salt and black pepper to taste

instructions.title: Form meatballs
instructions.text: Combine ground chicken, breadcrumbs, egg, and seasonings. Roll into small balls.

instructions.title: Bake meatballs
instructions.text: Place on a baking sheet and bake at 200°C (400°F) for 15-18 minutes.

instructions.title: Make cheese dip
instructions.text: Warm cream cheese with cream until smooth, stir in parsley, and serve with hot meatballs.
